gdp.zh: 世界银行 WDI 没有可与本应用匹配的台湾省地区生产总值独立序列，因此该指标保持缺失，不用其他来源替代或拆分全国数据。
gdp.en: The World Bank WDI has no separate GDP series for Taiwan Province that this atlas can match, so the value is left missing rather than substituted or split from a national total.

all.zh: 南极洲没有常住人口与经济核算序列；相关图层仅显示地形、冰盖与科研站点等可获得数据。
all.en: Antarctica has no resident population or national-accounts series; its layers only show available terrain, ice and research-station data.
